database._comment: No 'tables' key on purpose. base_sdk's own tables (KeyValueTable, OutboxTable, IdMappingsTable) are declared directly in the @DriftDatabase annotation in lib/src/database/app_database.dart, and the installer COPIES every table source named here into base_sdk's own package to import relatively - so listing them would compile two copies of each class. Only the migration is declared.
database._comment_migration: THE MIGRATION VERSION NUMBER IS SHARED WITH EVERY OTHER SDK IN THE APP, AND IS NOT THIS SDK'S TO COUNT ALONE. sdk_installer_base.py update_database_registration() sets the composed AppDatabase's schemaVersion to the MAXIMUM version any composed manifest declares, while each SDK writes its own `if (from < N)` guard into the one shared onUpgrade - one namespace, no allocator. Drift calls onUpgrade only when schemaVersion is GREATER than the stored user_version, so a number at or below the running maximum runs nothing at all on a device that is already there, and the column this step adds would simply never appear (productivity_sdk lost its notes table to exactly this, and this manifest's number is chosen the way that manifest's comment says to). Two further traps are specific to base: the composer SUBSTITUTES the schemaVersion getter in app_database.dart, so a base-owned number written only in Dart is erased at compose time; and max_version is only raised inside the installer's `if version and step` branch, so a version declared without a step raises nothing. Hence both, declared here. VERSIONS READ ACROSS THE FLEET BEFORE CLAIMING 19 (every manifest.json outside a .rokct/cache in every repo reachable from this workspace, read at their current main): radio_sdk 18 (agent/radio/dart), productivity_sdk 17 (productivity/productivity/dart), auth_sdk 16 (Users/auth/dart), agent_sdk 15 (agent/agent/dart), replay_sdk 15 (agent/replay/dart), subscriptions_sdk 15 (agent/subscriptions/dart), polaris_sdk 13 (corporate/polaris/dart), fav_sdk 12 (agent/fav/dart); no other manifest declares a database.migration at all - base_sdk, launch_sdk, comms_sdk and telemetry_sdk in this repo included, until now. 19 is above all of them. NOTE for whoever reads this next: radio_sdk's 17 and productivity_sdk's 17 are a LIVE COLLISION on that number (radio's own comment still records productivity at 14), which is not this PR's to fix but is the same defect all of this text is about. The step is idempotent - ensureOwnerScopeColumns() checks for the column before touching anything - and beforeOpen in app_database.dart calls it on every open as a floor, so a device that somehow skips this step still gets the column rather than throwing on its first read.

routes._comment: Path, route name and CupertinoRoute type match paas_driver's host-owned entry outside the generated markers, so host navigation call-sites keep working when the host deletes its manual entry + its own copy of the page (M2). The installed page carries @RoutePage(name auto-derived: HomeRoute); SDK lib/ pages never get a generated route class, which is why every routed page here is an installed template.

Since 1.21.0 the installed page is a host route shell (same route name, path and constructor) rendering base_sdk's GenericProfilePage inside a two-plane PlaneHost, with the driver's content registered on ProfileSectionRegistry (stats header slot, row list, Online helper) - the fleet pattern of merchants' restaurant_page.dart and marketplace's ProfileRoute shell. The path stays declared here because the home page's avatar and Profile tab push ProfileRoute and users_sdk's tour fragment navigates to /profile; the shell is what gives the host its plane cap and corner back pill, which base_sdk's bare /generic-profile route does not.

Design strip frames 49g/49h/49i: the deposit status plane; ?choose=1 opens the method chooser over it (corporate revenue_sdk's wallet plane pushes this path from its Top up pill - delivery_sdk imports only base_sdk, so the two SDKs meet on the path, not on a class).

Van sales - 'My load': the consignment load the shop issued this driver. Lists every open load with its lines (issued / sold / returned / remaining), the value still on the van, and the three actions Sell, Return, Close load, on commerce's api.order.load.* defs. The driver home's My load tile pushes the plane directly (same SDK, no route needed); the path is declared because the two write screens below live under it and a host may link the list itself.

The sale at the door: steppers capped at the server's remaining figure, a live total struck at the load's own unit prices, and a cash order born Delivered + Paid by api.order.load.create_load_sale. ?load=<load order> names the load; absent, the driver's only open load.
Unsold stock handed back to the shop (api.order.load.return_load). The same steppers and the same cap, and deliberately no money figure - a return is not a refund.

app_routes._comment: base_sdk's logged-in splash path (AppHelpers.goHome) calls AppRoutes.I.replaceMainRoute; nothing else in a driver compose declares it, so without this entry a logged-in cold start throws via _HostAppRoutes.noSuchMethod. The driver 'main' is the courier home map (/home, HomeRoute) - same pattern as launch_sdk's LauncherHomeRoute declaration.

boot_hooks._comment: Guarded like comms' firebase-fcm boot hook (platform allowlist + fail-open try/catch): workmanager only has Android/iOS implementations, so on a composed Windows exe the old unguarded 'await Workmanager().initialize(...)' threw 'No implementation found for workmanager on this platform' inside main() BEFORE runApp - the driver desktop build died before its first frame (window never shown). The allowlist mirrors the hms hook's capability-narrowed platform set; desktop/web now skip the courier background tracker entirely, which they never supported anyway.

integrations._comment: Pairs with auth_sdk >= 1.9.0's @auth-entry-config placeholder (Users repo). Ray's rule: Skip (guest entry) lives in the shared login page and shows in ALL apps by default; a home SDK that doesn't need it opts out — 'delivery and merchants dont need it'. On older auth_sdk the marker is absent and the installer only warns (wiring NOT applied), leaving behavior unchanged.

routes._comment: Path, route name and CupertinoRoute type match paas_driver's host-owned entry outside the generated markers, so delivery_sdk's installed driver profile_page (zones#12) keeps pushing NotificationListRoute unchanged when the driver repo deletes its manual entry + its own copy of the page (driver migration M2).

boot_hooks._comment: Live notifications (design approved 2026-09-26). Registers the device sink into base_sdk's LiveActivities (base_sdk >= 1.76.0), so orders, delivery and lms publish snapshots without importing comms_sdk. Registration only: nothing is drawn until an adopter publishes. No 'imports' entry: main.dart already imports base_sdk and comms_sdk (which exports DeviceLiveActivitySink).

Ray, 2026-09-25: ask for notification permission after a successful sign-in, in every app that composes comms_sdk (before 1.18.0 only merchants' manager shell and delivery's driver home asked; supacharge, paas_customer and the rest never did). Subscribes PushPermissionPrompt to base_sdk's SessionStartHooks (base_sdk >= 1.75.0), which auth_sdk >= 1.15.0 runs once a session is established; neither SDK depends on the other. PushPermissionPrompt skips demo sessions (DemoSession.demoActive), asks at most once per install (a LocalStorage JSON flag set only once the OS was actually asked), and goes through PushPermissionService, so platform guard, fail-open catch and in-flight de-duplication all still apply. Registration only: nothing runs at boot. No 'imports' entry: every composed main.dart already imports package:base_sdk/base_sdk.dart and package:comms_sdk/comms_sdk.dart (which exports PushPermissionPrompt) in its @generated-sdk-imports block.

Windows notification delivery, POS parity (1.6.0): firebase_messaging has no Windows implementation, so the FCM hook above deliberately excludes Windows and composed Windows exes shipped with NO notification path at all. This hook starts comms' DesktopNotificationPoller (10s REST count polling + looping POS notification.wav + ValueNotifier badge feed - see the service's doc comment) on Windows only. The start is deferred to addPostFrameCallback because boot-hook bodies run BEFORE LocalStorage.init() and the sdk-di block in the generated main.dart: by first frame both are done, and runApp is never delayed by a poll. Fail-open try/catch like the FCM hook - a boot failure debugPrints instead of blanking the app. WidgetsBinding resolves via main.dart's static material import; foundation dedupes with the FCM hook's wiring import. Toast layer (still 1.6.0, same unmerged PR): poller.start() also initializes LocalNotifications fail-open (flutter_local_notifications 19.x WindowsInitializationSettings - stable hardcoded GUID, APP_NAME/WINDOWS_AUMID dart-defines for branding, works unpackaged; MSIX identity optional host-side) and each count increase raises a native toast via LocalNotifications.show() alongside the sound - no hook body change needed, the toast path lives entirely inside the service.

Feeds received FCM messages into base_sdk's PushMessages (base_sdk >= 1.79.0) by data['type'], so a feature SDK handles its own pushes without importing comms_sdk (orders_sdk registers 'order_status' for its ActiveOrderTracker). Foreground messages and taps that open the app dispatch at once; a message that arrives while the app is suspended or closed is queued by firebaseMessagingBackgroundHandler and replayed at start and on resume. Runs after comms-firebase-fcm-boot (order 10). comms_sdk exports PushMessageDispatcher, so no package import is needed.

routes._comment: The installed page carries @RoutePage(name: 'DriverDeliveryZoneRoute'), so auto_route generates the route class in the host's own app_router.gr.dart - SDK lib/ pages never get one. update_router_table() owns the whole @generated-routes block, so a route not declared here is dropped on every recompose.

boot_hooks._comment: Registers this SDK's bundled English map for its manifest tr_keys into base_sdk's BundledTranslations registry at boot (weather_sdk's af pattern, applied to en). Needed because the approved section-39 zone-editor copy carries punctuation and casing the humanized-key fallback cannot reproduce. Backend-served translation rows still win; the map is only the offline/unseeded fallback consulted before the humanized-key fallback. Top-level (not app_type-gated) because translations are role-agnostic.

integrations._comment: Design strip frame 49l, commerce half of the seam (merchants_sdk >= 1.25.0): the merchants restaurant page never imports revenue_sdk (ADR-005 - SDKs import only base), so the pane arrives through the composer's substring-insert integration, the same mechanism productivity_sdk uses for its tasks-row line. This entry lands the barrel import under the column-0 imports marker; the pane entry below lands the widget. On a merchants_sdk without the markers the installer only warns (wiring NOT applied) and the hub keeps base's bare BaseWalletCard.

The placeholder carries its six-space indent ON PURPOSE: the bare text is a prefix of the -imports marker above, and the installer replaces every occurrence. The marker sits first inside MerchantWalletSection's candidate list and the section renders `.first`, so the inserted pane WINS over base's BaseWalletCard(actions: [], onHistory: null) that follows it; nothing is deleted. merchantWalletScope(ref) is the host page's own seam function (shop id + display name from restaurantProvider, cached shop JSON as fallback), so this replacement names no merchants internals beyond it. Byte-for-byte twin of merchants_sdk's markers - test/hub_markers_test.dart there pins both strings.

routes._comment: Path, route name and CupertinoRoute type match paas_driver's host-owned entry outside the generated markers, so host navigation call-sites keep working when the host deletes its manual entry + its own copy of the page (M2). The installed page carries @RoutePage() (name auto-derived: StoryRoute) — delivery_sdk's installed home stores.dart tile pushes `const StoryRoute()` (zones#12).

boot_hooks._comment: Registers this SDK's bundled English map into base_sdk's BundledTranslations registry at boot (lms_sdk's 'af' hook is the precedent). base_sdk bundles no 'en' map because English normally survives through the humanized-key fallback, but that only holds for keys named after their copy: reset_password_text humanized to the literal "Reset password text" on every app shell's reset-password sheet, because demo builds take their served map from comms_sdk's MockSettingsRepository (a handful of rows that never carried this key). Backend-served translation rows still win; the map is only the offline/unseeded fallback consulted before the humanized-key fallback. Imports are declared explicitly (src paths, like lms_sdk) because neither symbol is exported by the auth_sdk barrel every composed main.dart already imports. Requires a base_sdk with bundled_translations.dart (the bundled-af wave).

embedded_widgets._comment: Header slot (ADR-005): shells embed the compact adaptive widget without importing weather_sdk directly. inlineExpansion=false because headers are height-constrained; on small screens that leaves just the minimal icon+temp chip, and the popup-free WeatherInlineForecast card is placed in body flow via the weather_sdk barrel (it takes a WeatherState argument, so it cannot ride the zero-arg embedded-widget seam).

Severe-weather heads-up banner (zero-arg seam, ADR-005): hosts place it in body flow; it renders SizedBox.shrink() whenever there are no active warnings, the warnings cmd fails, or the composed backend does not expose tenant.api.get_weather_warnings yet - so embedding it is always safe, in any merge order with the backend rollout. Location comes from the same WeatherSdkConfig.locationResolver the header widget's install template wires.

boot_hooks._comment: Registers this SDK's bundled Afrikaans map for its manifest tr_keys into base_sdk's BundledTranslations registry at boot. Top-level (not app_type-gated) because translations are role-agnostic. Backend-served translation rows still win; the map is only the offline/unseeded fallback consulted before the humanized-key fallback. Requires a base_sdk with bundled_translations.dart.

Driver shells render no weather header widget (whose build is what lazily runs configureWeatherSdk() on pos/manager), so without this hook nothing would set the courier locationResolver before the severe-weather banner's first warnings fetch. One idempotent call at startup; cheap no-op if the host later renders AppWeatherWidget too.

Order 30: after comms' Firebase/FCM boot (10) and its desktop notification poller (20) - order 20 is already taken and duplicate orders draw a composer warning. Android-only and fail-open like comms' hooks. The initialize() call itself is a strict no-op unless DeviceServices proves the device GMS-free AND HMS-capable, so GMS devices and detection errors keep comms_sdk's FCM path as the sole push owner. The await is cheap: initialize() only awaits the availability probe and turnOnPush - the push token arrives asynchronously on Push Kit's token stream, so runApp is never delayed by a token round-trip.
